presets.name: Lead WarmRes
presets.patchNotes: This DRONE synthesizer patch is built around a hollow square wave paired with a deep sub-oscillator. It passes through a muted, low-pass filtered filter section. The amplitude envelope is characterized by a  gradual, swelling attack and a long, ambient release tail. Active LFO modulation introduces movement. It sits in a lush wash of delay and reverb.
